title: Add Promptzy to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [Promptzy](https://promptzy.pinkpixel.dev) to build
- Manage and organize AI prompts with tagging and search in Promptzy, available as a web/desktop app with cloud storage.

Fixes #11204

gist.headline: Prompts, neatly pollinated
gist.blurb: Promptzy joined the garden: a place to tag, search, and keep AI prompts from wandering off into the tall grass. It works on the web and desktop, with cloud storage for the important little spells.
gist.summary: Added Promptzy to the app catalog, a web and desktop app for organizing AI prompts with tags, search, and cloud storage.
gist.impact: People exploring the Pollinations app ecosystem can now find a dedicated tool for keeping reusable prompts searchable and organized across devices.
gist.visual_concept: Depict Promptzy as a cozy prompt garden: labeled seed packets and glowing note cards sorted into tiny tagged drawers, with a magnifying glass representing search and a soft cloud-shaped storage shelf. Polli wears a tiny librarian hat and carefully files a prompt card while a few code-plants and flowers grow around the desk.
gist.image_prompt: Cozy pixel art scene of Polli, the cute yellow-and-brown striped bee mascot with pink cheek blush, light blue wings, and a tiny librarian hat, organizing glowing prompt note cards into tagged garden drawers beside a magnifying glass and a soft cloud-storage shelf. Lime green (#ecf874) appears prominently among warm cream, mint, lavender, and peach code-plants and flowers; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, with small pixel-font text: 'PROMPTZY'.
